gas.how: median gasUsed of our real Oct 8 relay receipts x baseFeePerGas of the landing block (effectiveGasPrice == baseFee on all 18 relay receipts)

arming_rpc_receipt_lag_probe.what: LIVE probe on Oct 9 from this container (through its HTTPS proxy, not the box): feed message -> public RPC serves the receipt (arm_launch's wait_receipt, 40 ms polls)
arming_rpc_receipt_lag_probe.not_measurable_from_chain: when the RPC served the launch receipt on Oct 8 is in no log; the chain only shows block timestamps (1 s resolution)

crowd_slippage.amountOutMinimum: 90% of the quote; the three burst buys quoted on the same pre-burst state
